channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-104935 — Ivanti Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2023-50224 — TP-Link TL-WR841N
item.description: Threat Signal 57. TP-Link TL-WR841N contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default, leading to the disclose of stored credentials. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2026-86950 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-40444 — Microsoft MSHTML
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft MSHTML contains a unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-32201 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft SharePoint Server contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-35616 — Fortinet FortiClient EMS
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.

item.title: CVE-2025-47813 — Wing FTP Server Wing FTP Server
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Wing FTP Server contains a generation of error message containing sensitive information vulnerability when using a long value in the UID cookie.

item.title: CVE-2021-39935 — GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
item.description: Threat Signal 64. GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability which could allow unauthorized external users to perform Server Side Requests via the CI Lint API.

item.title: CVE-2025-14174 — Google Chromium
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Google Chromium contains an out of bounds memory access vulnerability in ANGLE that could allow a remote attacker to perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-2533 — PaperCut NG/MF
item.description: Threat Signal 64. PaperCut NG/MF contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability, which, under specific conditions, could potentially enable an attacker to alter security settings or execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2025-2775 — SysAid SysAid On-Prem
item.description: Threat Signal 64. SysAid On-Prem contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability in the Checkin processing functionality, allowing for administrator account takeover and file read primitives.

item.title: CVE-2019-6693 — Fortinet FortiOS
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Fortinet FortiOS contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an attacker to cipher sensitive data in FortiOS configuration backup file via knowledge of the hard-coded key.

item.title: CVE-2025-31200 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain a memory corruption vulnerability that allows for code execution when processing an audio stream in a maliciously crafted media file.

item.title: CVE-2024-57968 — Advantive VeraCore
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Advantive VeraCore contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to upload files to unintended folders via upload.apsx.

item.title: CVE-2025-24085 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Apple iOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain a user-after-free vulnerability that could allow a malicious application to elevate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-40407 — Reolink RLC-410W IP Camera
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Reolink RLC-410W IP cameras contain an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability in the device network settings functionality.

item.title: CVE-2023-29336 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation up to SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2011-1823 — Android Android OS
item.description: Threat Signal 64. The vold volume manager daemon in Android kernel trusts messages from a PF_NETLINK socket, which allows an attacker to execute code and gain root privileges. This vulnerability is associated with GingerBreak and Exploit.AndroidOS.Lotoor.

item.title: CVE-2019-5825 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2017-5070 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2014-0546 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Adobe Reader and Acrobat on Windows allow attackers to bypass a sandbox protection mechanism, and consequently execute native code in a privileged context.

item.title: CVE-2013-3993 — IBM InfoSphere BigInsights
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Certain APIs within BigInsights can take invalid input that might allow attackers unauthorized access to read, write, modify, or delete data.

item.title: CVE-2013-2423 — Oracle Java Runtime Environment (JRE)
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Unspecified vulnerability in hotspot for Java Runtime Environment (JRE) allows remote attackers to affect integrity.

item.title: CVE-2017-0149 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted website.

item.title: CVE-2015-5123 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Use-after-free vulnerability in the BitmapData class in the ActionScript 3 (AS3) implementation in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2022-26871 — Trend Micro Apex Central
item.description: Threat Signal 64. An arbitrary file upload vulnerability in Trend Micro Apex Central could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2013-3660 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 64. The EPATHOBJ::pprFlattenRec function in win32k.sys in the kernel-mode drivers in Microsoft does not properly initialize a pointer for the next object in a certain list, which allows local users to gain privileges.

item.title: CVE-2018-0147 — Cisco Secure Access Control System (ACS)
item.description: Threat Signal 64. A vulnerability in Java deserialization used by Cisco Secure Access Control System (ACS) could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands on an affected device. The vulnerability is due to insecure deserialization of user-supplied content by the affected software.

item.title: CVE-2016-4171 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-0222 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 64. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when Internet Explorer improperly accesses objects in memory.

item.title: CVE-2021-1647 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft Defender contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-17144 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft Exchange Server improperly validates cmdlet arguments which allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-1464 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft Windows contains a spoofing vulnerability when Windows incorrectly validates file signatures, allowing an attacker to bypass security features and load improperly signed files.

item.title: CVE-2010-5326 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 64. SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms Invoker Servlet does not require authentication, allowing for remote code execution via a HTTP or HTTPS request.

item.title: CVE-2016-3976 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 64. SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a directory traversal vulnerability via a ..\ (dot dot backslash) in the fileName parameter to CrashFileDownloadServlet. This allows remote attackers to read files.

item.title: CVE-2026-58704 — Google Pixel
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-86060 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 63. MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-87491 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2026-72530 — TrueConf Server
item.description: Threat Signal 63. TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.

item.title: CVE-2026-72529 — TrueConf Server
item.description: Threat Signal 63. TrueConf Server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthorized attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to execute an arbitrary script.

item.title: CVE-2026-18577 — N-able N-central
item.description: Threat Signal 63. N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel allows for authentication bypass and account takeover in N-central. This vulnerability is the result of an incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556.

item.title: CVE-2026-20245 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager formerly SD-WAN vManage contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated, local attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root by supplying a crafted file to the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2026-20133 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to view sensitive information on affected systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-34197 — Apache ActiveMQ
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Apache ActiveMQ contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for code injection.

item.title: CVE-2026-21513 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft MSHTML Framework contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-20045 — Cisco Unified Communications Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Cisco Unified Communications Manager (Unified CM), Cisco Unified Communications Manager Session Management Edition (Unified CM SME), Cisco Unified Communications Manager IM & Presence Service (Unified CM IM&P), Cisco Unity Connection, and Cisco Webex Calling Dedicated Instance contain a code injection vulnerability that could allow the attacker to obtain user-level access to the underlying operating system and then elevate privileges to root.

item.title: CVE-2025-66644 — Array Networks ArrayOS AG
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Array Networks ArrayOS AG contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2021-26829 — OpenPLC ScadaBR
item.description: Threat Signal 63. OpenPLC ScadaBR contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via system_settings.shtm.

item.title: CVE-2025-20352 — Cisco IOS and IOS XE
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem that could allow for denial of service or remote code execution. A successful exploit could allow a low-privileged attacker to cause the affected system to reload, resulting in a DoS condition, or allow a high-privileged attacker to execute arbitrary code as the root user and obtain full control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2025-24054 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Windows NTLM contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
